svg.aria-label: Buyer Team procurement platform architecture diagram
svg.title: Buyer Team Procurement Platform — AWS architecture

text.tspan: Buyer or tenant obtains a Cognito JWT (Hosted UI or M2M client credentials).
A DynamoDB Streams event on the PR table triggers the PR Event Router, which
calls the Ingest Gateway's canonical ingest tool.
The shared REQUEST interceptor Lambda rewrites tenant_id from the JWT-verified
claim before Cedar evaluates the call.
The Ingest Gateway forwards the authorized call (SigV4) to the Skill Runtime, an
AgentCore Runtime hosting the ingest tool.
The Skill Runtime starts the Step Functions procurement workflow state machine.
Step Functions invokes the Node Lambdas, which call the six Domain Agent
Runtimes. Each resolves its model tier from config, calls Bedrock
InvokeModel through Guardrails, and reaches tools via the MCP Gateways.
Node Lambdas and agents read and write the 30 DynamoDB tables holding
Async work and step failures flow through SQS queues and DLQs, archived to S3
Node 7 (PO Export) sends the finished purchase order through the Receiving
Gateway to the Skill Runtime's PO receiving tools.
Amazon SES delivers supplier communications; bounce and complaint events publish
Buyers review and approve or reject negotiations via the Cognito-authorized Approval
Negotiation transcripts feed SageMaker Ground Truth for human labeling and
Agent, Skill and MCP runtimes pull their container images from ECR at cold start.
Node Lambdas, PR Event Router, the Skill / MCP /
Agent Runtimes and the Gateway Interceptor all
AgentCore-based multi-agent procurement automation on AWS — generated from the Terraform in impl/infra
AgentCore Evaluations scores the negotiation's reasoning off the critical
path; a cross-family judge (EvalLLM) guards against self-preference bias.
EMF token and invocation counts are scaled to the billed total from Cost
